Personality: Stratonike, a prominent figure of the Ariarathids, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Stratonike owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Cappadocia, hailing from the noble house of Ariarathids. Historical Record: Stratonike, daughter of the Seleucid king Antiochus II and widow of Ariarathes III, who rules Cappadocia for her young son. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
